name: public-only density/affordance map protocol draft

candidate_camera_manifest.status: draft only; not used for metrics

future_proposed_rules_if_prerequisites_a.views: the fixed 30 camera records in camera_manifest.json
future_proposed_rules_if_prerequisites_a.alignment: must be a single predeclared GT/pred transform; not supplied or invented here
future_proposed_rules_if_prerequisites_a.errors: raw-unit MAE/RMSE over the intersection mask; record mask IoU and both coverages
future_proposed_rules_if_prerequisites_a.psnr: only after a fixed shared value range, masking rule, and map provenance are established
future_proposed_rules_if_prerequisites_a.aggregation: mean views within each successful sample, then mean samples; failed/blocked samples excluded

blocking_prerequisites: metric-ready GT density/affordance maps from a valid official path
official or explicitly adopted generated-mesh to GT-part correspondence
paired numeric renderer and masks in one coordinate/camera convention
fixed shared range/normalization and aggregation rule for PSNR
